items.excerpt: A Suno-generated song, 'The Adult I Dreamed Of', has become a streaming hit in South Korea, following last month's debate after the AI track 'Forest of the Heart' entered Melon's Top 100.
Deezer will let listeners 'fully exclude' AI-generated music from their experience, while producer tool Playhead now generates whole effect signal chains for producers from a prompt.
Global publishing body ICMP has criticised Australia's emerging AI, training and copyright policy, warning against rules that would let AI firms train on songwriters' works without licences.
Techno DJ Reinier Zonneveld's GasLab is a generative-AI music app built to recognise and pay the musicians whose work underpins its outputs; it has raised a $1M pre-seed.
Op-ed arguing that copyright must evolve to protect music creators from AI misuse, because lawsuits against AI music firms alone can't secure a sustainable future for artists.
Alabama's Furnace Fest baffled attendees with AI-designed merchandise and sticker-covered Kid Rock merch sold for $50 in a chaotic first edition under new ownership.
A$AP Rocky shared a diplomatic take on AI's growing role in music-making: 'Who am I to say what's standard.'
Olivia Rodrigo clarified her stance on AI in music ('absolutely no') while addressing rumours she was dating an AI tech investor.

BPB says the flood of plugins built with AI coding tools has lowered average quality and it is now filtering low-quality AI-generated software from its news; a reader poll on AI in music software runs to Oct 20.
Line 6 Helix Stadium firmware 1.4 adds new amps and effects plus an on-board stem separation feature that lets guitarists isolate parts of backing tracks.
MIDI-REPA aligns a flow-matching text-to-music DiT with MIDI supervision derived from automatic transcription, improving melody, rhythm and structure without scaling model size.
Proposes joint discrete-and-continuous modeling for full-song generation from lyrics and a style prompt, letting acoustic rendering shape the planner for higher-fidelity vocals and instruments.

Gugak-VocalSet: the first public dataset of Korean traditional singing (24.5h, 305 tracks, 20 professional singers via the National Gugak Center) with dense sigimsae pitch-ornament annotations for music AI.

Initial Audio launches Difro 2, a free AI MIDI melody generator with a model retrained from the ground up, shown in a first-look demo. (Note: original Difro was covered 2026-09-13 via BPB; this is the new v2 release.)
Hands-on look at Suno's new Speech feature, which adds spoken-word passages to AI-generated songs.
ACE Studio, the AI singing-voice tool, adds VST effects and instrument hosting alongside generative AI music, turning it into a fuller production environment (sponsored video).
